dataList.title: To the Footwear Hall
dataList.description: We've arrived at 4F. Let's follow the Corridor to the Footwear Hall.

steps.goalDescription1: Follow the corridor to the Footwear Hall

dataList.title: Head to the Footwear Hall
dataList.description: We gave a name to the child following us—"Pwie". They still seem a little wary of us... But for now, our priority should be to head to the Footwear Hall on 4F, just like before.

steps.goalDescription1: Talk to whoever's left in the Footwear Hall

dataList.title: Head to the Furniture Hall
dataList.description: Dorothea from Le Rouge's Footwear Hall asked us to find a shard of heart so she can find her way home. In return, she'll tell us how to reach 5F. Head to the Furniture Hall to find what she wants.

steps.goalDescription1: Head to the Happy Closet in the Furniture Hall

dataList.title: Talk to the Arc Floor Lamp
dataList.description: The Happy Closet in the Furniture Hall still refuses to say a word. We pried a few things loose from them. Time to head over to the Arc Floor Lamp.

steps.goalDescription1: Talk to the Arc Floor Lamp
Take the clothing to the Arc Floor Lamp

dataList.title: Return to the Happy Closet
dataList.description: We gave the Arc Floor Lamp the clothing we took from the Happy Closet. Now the other Furnishings are clamoring for outfits of their own. Head back to the Happy Closet.

dataList.title: Deliver the Clothes to the Furnishings
dataList.description: Once again, the Happy Closet gave up what they had without complaint. Deliver the clothes to the Furnishings.

dataList.title: Ask the Happy Closet whether we can get a shard of heart
dataList.description: We've finished helping the Furnishings. Time to ask the Happy Closet for a shard of heart.

steps.goalDescription1: Ask the Happy Closet whether we can get a shard of heart
The Furnishings are ripping the Happy Closet apart.

dataList.title: Inspect the Happy Closet's remains
dataList.description: The Furnishings tore the Happy Closet apart in their scramble for their belongings, then turned on each other until no one was left standing. Let's search the Happy Closet's remains.

dataList.title: Head to the Rouge Footwear Hall
dataList.description: Our business with the Noir Footwear Hall is done. Time to head to the Rouge's Footwear Hall just next door below.

steps.goalDescription1: Head to the Rouge Footwear Hall

dataList.title: Return to the Rouge Footwear Hall
dataList.description: We managed to collect a shard of heart from the Happy Closet. Let's return to Le Rouge's Footwear Hall and give it to Dorothea.

steps.goalDescription1: Return to the Rouge Footwear Hall

dataList.title: Follow Dorothea
dataList.description: We gave Dorothea the shard of heart taken from the Happy Closet, and she agreed to tell us how to get to 5F. Let's follow her.

dataList.title: The Hole in the Wall
dataList.description: There's hole in the wall. We should inspect it.

dataList.title: Head into the Hole
dataList.description: Dorothea clicked her shoes together, and an opening appeared in the wall. Let's head inside.

dataList.title: Follow the Abnormality
dataList.description: The passage led us to a place called the Lost Child Center. An Abnormality appeared and carried Dorothea away. We should go after it.

dataList.title: Inspect the Abnormality's Remains
dataList.description: We dealt with the Abnormality. Let's inspect its remains.

dataList.title: Inspect the Abnormality's Remains
dataList.description: The abducted Dorothea is lying on the floor. Let's inspect her.

dataList.title: Head to the Other Stores
dataList.description: Pwie has a fine new pair of shoes. There still seems to be stores on 4F we haven't visited yet. Let's go check them out.

steps.goalDescription2: Talk to the other employee in the Handbags Hall

dataList.title: Inspect the Wall in the Le Rouge Handbags Hall
dataList.description: We should check the wall out.

dataList.title: What was Hidden Behind the Wall?
dataList.description: The one who was hidden behind the wall revealed herself. We should decide what to do with her.

steps.goalDescription1: Decide what to do with Renée

dataList.title: Decide what to do with Renée
dataList.description: Wait for the decision to be carried out.

steps.goalDescription1: Decide what to do with Renée

dataList.title: Head to the Other Stores
dataList.description: Our business in the Rouge Handbags Hall is done. Time to check out the other store.

dataList.title: Collect the Golden material
dataList.description: The designer at Le Noir's Handbags Hall asked us to gather some Golden materials. Help out so we can obtain information about where to find the escalator to the 5F. The materials can be taken from Mannequins.

dataList.title: Return to the designer at the Noir Handbags Hall
dataList.description: We've collected all the Golden materials requested. Time to head back to the designer.

steps.goalDescription1: Return to the designer at the Noir Handbags Hall

dataList.title: Take the Escalator to 5F
dataList.description: Our business in the Handbags Hall is done. We should head to the escalator leading to 5F.
